features.feature_value: Removes posts described as too hateful or personal.
features.evidence_span: If a post was too hateful or personal I removed them
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states a keep/remove rule based on hate or personal nature.

features.feature_value: Keeps unless posts are disrespectful, with increased blocking for bullying/attacks.
features.evidence_span: if the posters are being respectful to one another
features.rationale: They use respect and absence of personal attacks as the main criterion, with bullying/attacking as a removal trigger.

features.feature_value: Assesses whether language seems argumentative rather than truthful.
features.evidence_span: some of the language used in the post was more so somebody wanting to argue rather than say the truth
features.rationale: The reflection ties their judgment to whether wording appears to be for arguing instead of conveying truth.

features.feature_value: Allows standard policy debate/criticism but removes when language is vulgar/toxic or uses historical Nazi analogies.
features.evidence_span: only chose to remove them when the language became too vulgar, toxic, or used historical Nazi analogies
features.rationale: They specify concrete removal thresholds tied to particular content types.

features.feature_value: Keeps based on whether comments encourage discussion/engagement rather than insulting people or concepts.
features.evidence_span: considered whether the comments encouraged discussion and engagement
features.rationale: The participant describes an evaluation lens centered on encouraging discussion versus insulting.

features.feature_value: Removal likelihood rises with hostility, blatant insults, or cursing; perceived as leading conversation to a bad place.
features.evidence_span: hostility behind the words and blatant insults or cursing
features.rationale: They directly connect linguistic hostility/insults/cursing to a negative conversational outcome.

features.feature_value: Uses the pairing to better see the message and its effect on liberals/US broadly since Trump took the lead.
features.evidence_span: reflect on how things have been since Trump took the lead
features.rationale: Their reflection frames the influence as coming from clearer political-context interpretation of the paired messages.

features.feature_value: Allows both versions when both seem reasonable and not too critical/insane to delete.
features.evidence_span: If they both seemed reasonable I allowed both
features.rationale: They describe a keep rule conditioned on both versions appearing reasonable.
